tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig gi bsnyen sgrub las brtsams pa'i dris lan cung zad bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ ji phebs 'phags ma'i snying tig gi bsnyen pa'i skabs/ lam mos sgom gtso bor bton pa'i dbang du byas nas bsnyen sgrub las gsum dang sbyar ba'i bsnyen pa dkyus ma dang*/ nges rdzogs khyad par can gyi dbang du byas na/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i sgrom nas 'don pa sogs rnams bzhag mang po mchis kyang*/ skabs don las byang rang gis dngos bstan tsam gyis bsnyen sgrub las gsum la/ dus grangs rtags gsum las/ dus dbang po rab kyi dbang du byas te/ bsnyen pa la bdun gsum/ bsgrub pa la bdun gcig las sbyor la zhag gcig gcas/ dngos grub blang ba dang bcas zla ba gcig tu gsungs/ 'bring la de sum 'gyur du byas pas zla ba gsum/ tha ma zla ba drug shugs kyis thob/ grangs bsnyen kyang rab 'bring tha ma'i dbang po'i ngo skal du byas na/ de dang de'i dus kyi yun tshad la ji tsam 'grub pa yin mod/ spyir btang grangs gtso che ba'i dbang du byas na gtso mo'i yig bcu 'bru 'bum/ dril sgrub kyi bsnyen sngags 'bru bcu dgu pa 'bum phrag bdun/ ye shes sems dpa' dang*/ sprul pa'i sems ma'i sngags 'bum phrag bzhi re/ sgrol ma rigs bzhi'i sgrub sngags 'bum phrag re re/ las sbyor sgo ma bzhi'i sngags khri phrag bzhi re las nyung mtha' byas pa bzlas nas grangs bsnyen 'bring po dang*/ dus bsnyen dbang po 'bring gi zla ba gsum dang gzhi mthun par 'gyur ba shin tu legs/ las rung tsam la ni gtso mo'i yig bcu 'bum phra bzhi/ dril sgrub 'bum phrag /ye sems dang sprul pa'i sngags khri bzhi/ sgrub sngags khri re/ las sbyor nyin gcig ci 'grub byas pas dbang po rab kyi dus bsnyen dang gzhi mthun/ rtag bsnyen rab 'bring tha gsum ni spyi ltar/ dngos grub len lugs ni/ khyad par ba la sgrub chen khog dbub dang sbyar ba'i tshul yod kyang*/

dkyus tsam la las sbyor gyi sngags grangs de ring thems pa'i nangs par snga bar mchod gtor sogs gsar pa bshams/ dngos grub kyi rdzas 'du bya/ bzlas pa rdzogs nas stong tshig gis mchod bstod rjes/ dngos grub bskur ba'i dzab dril sgrub mthar/ kā ya wā ka tsitta sogs btags pa ci rigs pa bzla/ de nas ye shes sku mchog ni bshags pa dang*/ gzhung gi byin 'bebs bcas sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod bstod rgyas pa'i mthar/ oṃ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sogs kyis dngos grub gsol te/ dmigs pa spyi ltar dang bcas bum pa mgo thog bzhag cing bum chu myang*/ bdud rtsi mgrin par bzhag cing rol/ tshe 'brang snying gar bzhag /thod pa'i rdzas myang zhing lhag ma yun du bsten pa spyi ltar/ de nas tshogs mchod rgyas pas mtshon las mjug bsdu ba lags/ ༈ /dkyil 'khor zhi dkyil rta bab snam brgyad ma spyi 'gre/ 'dod snam dmar po mchod lha bcu drug /rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang du 'jig rten pa'i khor yug la dpal mgon don lnga sogs dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba yin kyang*/ bris cha'i tshe khor yug ma gtogs lha mtshan bri mi dgos/ ༈ /yab gar dbang sku mdog gzhung du/ /rang 'od thabs mchog gar gyi dbang*/ zhes rang gi 'od las skyes pa'i thabs kyi snang cha lags pas dkar po yin pa gzhir bzhag la/ yab yum go ldog lhan skyes 'di rigs yum las yab chags nyams che bar bshad pas dmar mdangs chags pa zhig bsgom pa dang*/ bri ba'i skabs su'ang 'di kho na legs snang*/ ༈ /rnam rgyal ma la phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du brkyangs te sdigs mdzub kyis lcags kyu 'gugs thabs su bsnams pa/ g.yon pas thugs ka'i thad du mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas tshe'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs bzhin pa bsnams pa/ zhabs sems ma'i skyil krung can du bsgom pas khyab/ bris 'bur lta bur mdzes pa btsal na thugs kar mchog sbyin gyi rgyas me tog utpal yu ba bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar mchog sbyin gyi rgyas 'phyar stabs su mdzad kyang rung ngo*/

༈ /sgo bzhi'i sgrol ma ni/ zhabs g.yas bskum pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs/ phyag g.yas pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du brkyangs nas skyabs sbyin sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas rang rtags lcags kyu gdengs pa sogs rnam 'gyur can/ g.yon thugs kar mchog sbyin gyi rgyas utpal la 'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba bsnams pa yin/ sngags phreng 'khor lugs/ bsnyen pa la bkod pa/ nye bsnyen la 'khor ba/ sgrub pa la do li/ sgrub chen spro bsdu gtso bor gsungs mod/ dkyus tsam la bkod pa'i dmigs pa kho nas 'thus/ de'i tshe lha mo'i rigs dang*/ ma rgyud skor phal cher la g.yon bskor du bkod pa shas che mod/ 'dir ni gsar ma'i rgyud sgrub thabs rnams las kyang g.yas bskor du bkod pa sha stag bshad pas/ rtsa sngags/ dril sgrub/ ye sems dang*/ sprul pa'i sngags bcas g.yas skor du bkod cing*/ de la sems bzung nas zin pa na 'od zer spro bsdu dang bcas bzlas pa mdzad pas 'thus/ bkod pa'i dmigs pa shin tu gsal na 'khor ba'i dmigs pa gsal btab kyang rung*/ de yang rtsa sngags bzla skabs de rkyang dang*/ dril sgrub skabs de'i mjug tu sngags de mthud nas gsal btab/ ye shes sems dpa'i skabs de'i dmigs pa gzhag nas thugs ston/ tām̐ hrīḥr bsgyur ba'i mthar rang sngags dgod/ sprul par thugs kar nyi zla'i ga'u'i dbus su bhrūm̐ mthar sngags phreng bkod pa lags/ sgrub pa'i sngags sogs la'ang rang gi thugs kar pad zla'i steng du thugs srog /tām̐ bhrūm̐ hrīḥhūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ bcas rang mdog gi mthar sngags phreng bkod pa sogs mdzad pas mthus/ ༈ /bzla lugs bsnyen pa'i skabs bsnyen dmigs rkyang pa ma gtogs sgrub pa man chad mi dgos/ sngags kyang thog mar yig bcu kho na gtso bor bzla/ thun zhabs su bsnyen sngags gzhan rnams cung zad re bzlas pas mthus/ sgrub pa'i skabs bsnyen pa'i sngags gtso mo/

ye sems sprul pa'i lha mo'i bzlas pa bcas cung zad re byas nas lha so sor sems bzung gsal snang thon pa na gtso mo'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis 'khor bskul ba'i spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang sbyar te/ thog mar thun gyi dngos gzhir rdo rje sgrol ma'i sngags kho na bsags/ thun mthar gzhan gsum yang cung zad re bzla/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sngags rdzogs nas/ de cung zad dang dngos gzhir rin chen sgrol ma'i sngags bzla ba sogs 'dra/ las sbyor mi dgos/ 'di skabs dril sgrub kyi sngags ma bzlas kyang rung*/ las sbyor skabs nyin rer thun bzhi re bcad/ dus gnad dang mthun par/ tho rengs la mtshon na bsnyen sgrub gnyis bzlas dmigs 'khyugs tsam re byas nas/ gtso 'khor lnga'i 'od kyi lcags kyus sgrol ma'i thugs rgyud bskul nas zhi ba'i las bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa de'i sngags gtso bor bzla/ thun mthar gzhan gsum cung zad re bzlas pas 'thus shing*/ nyi shar du zhags pa'i sgrol ma'i sngags gtso bor byed pa sogs 'gre/ ༈ /rang bzhin sgrub mchod sogs kyi skabs/ spyir btang gi sgrub mchod dkyus ma yin na/ thun rer gtso mo'i yig bcu stong phrag gcig bzla ba'i dbang du byas na/ dril sgrub/ ye sems/ sprul pa'i sngags bcas sum brgya/ /rigs bzhi brgya phrag las bzhi nyer gcig tsam bzlas na 'tshams par 'ong*/ tshe sgrub gtso bor bton pa yin na gzhan gong ltar la yig bcu sum brgya/ tshe sgrub sngags dmigs kyis bsal ba dril sgrub yin pas stong phrag bzla/ gzhan 'dra/ ༈ /rgyun khyer chags med lta bu la bsnyen pa'i sngags kho na las sgrub pa las sbyor ma byas kyang rung*/ bsnyen sngags kyang dril sgrub gtso bor byed na legs/ spro na sgrub pa las sbyor gyi zlas dmigs 'khyugs tsam gyis kyang 'gal ba med par ma zad bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi gzhi bsnyen sngon du song ba yin na/ nges par sgrub pa dang las sbyor cung zad re btags na legs pa yin no/

༈ /sgrub pa'i dngul chu ni/ bcud len gyi rdzas grub pa ste ston zla ltar dkar ba/ nyi ma lta bu'i 'od zer can g.yas skor du 'khyil zhing grub pa'i rtags g.yung drung dang*/ dga' 'khyil la sogs pa bkra shis pa'i ri mo sna tshogs pa bkra ba/ nus pa gang la reg pa tsam gyis glang po che'i stobs/ nyi zla'i tshe/ rdo rje'i lus/ bcu drug gi lang tsho can du bsgyur nus shing*/ lcags la reg pa tsam gyis gser du 'gyur ba dang*/ shing skam la gtor ba tsam gyis lo 'bras me tog phun sum tshogs pa skad cig gis 'byung ba zhig ste/ de lta bu'i rnam pa bde ba chen po'i gzi byin 'bar bar bsgom pa lags/ ༈ /sgrub gtor chen mo ni/ 'di'i sgrub khog gter chen mchog gling pa'i sa gter las byon pa'i shog ser ma las rgyas par bshad kyang*/ sgrub chen dus yin na las dkyus su mi dgos shing*/ dpe'u ris lta bu zhib cha zhig byas na ma gtogs bca' bzo dka' ba zhig lags/ dkyus su dkyil thang yod na dgram pa'am/ med na maṇḍal tshom bu tsam dang*/ gtso bor thod pa ril bu bcas sgrub rten khyad par ba lags pas/ sgrub gtor logs su ma dgos/ mchod gtor ni rin chen 'bar ba spyi 'gres 'thus/ de la shes pa bzhi ldan sogs kyi tha snyad sbyar na sgrub gtor dang mchod gtor gzhi mthun par dbyibs rin po cher mnga' ba ltar lags/ tshe 'brang ni/ tshe zhes nas rjen 'thag /gal chen chang gis sbrus pa'i zan bum dbyibs spyi 'gre mtha' ril bus bskor ba kha dog dmar po byas pa de ga lags/ kā ya ā yuu ṣaḥdhwa dza tiṣṭhantu// //
